subject: Consumption gateway design + entitlement handoff (AWS Marketplace)
messages:
From: Stuart H. <stuart@acmelabs.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Labs Procurement <procurement@acmelabs.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consumption gateway design + entitlement handoff (AWS Marketplace)

Neha —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Our procurement and engineering leads asked for a short write-up so they can align on the handoff between AWS Marketplace fulfillment and our internal entitlement system. High level asks from Acme:

- How will the marketplace metering events translate into an Acme seat/credit entitlement?
- What happens for overlapping subscriptions and prorations?
- Evidence/files they can attach to their purchase order (SOC2 certs, SLA summary).

We sketched something internally and attached a short list of procurement questions (acme-procurement-questions.pdf). Can you share a proposed gateway sequence (API handoff, webhook reliability, retry/backfill guidance) and a mapping of entitlement states we should expect? Also, timeline: procurement wants go/no-go in the next two weeks.

--
Stuart H.
Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Labs

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Stuart H. <stuart@acmelabs.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption gateway design + entitlement handoff (AWS Marketplace)

Stuart —

Thanks for the clear asks. I attached a proposed gateway sequence diagram (proposed-gateway-sequence.png) and a CSV mapping of entitlement states (entitlement-state-map.csv). High level summary below — we can sync with your engineering/procurement folks if helpful.

Summary (short):
- AWS Marketplace metering -> Redwood ingestion -> Handoff to Acme via entitlement webhook + reconciliation API.
- For onboarding, initial entitlement is created with a pending state until AWS fulfillment confirms charge; then we move to active. We surface both marketplace transaction id and our internal entitlement id to your system for reconciliation.
- Prorations: Redwood will surface prorated units in the metering event payload (field: prorate_factor). We recommend authoritative reconciliation run weekly with backfill window of 31 days.

Recommended next steps:
1) Tech sync (30–45 min) to agree payload and retries (we support exponential backoff and idempotency-key).
2) Procurement handshake: we’ll provide SOC2 summary, SLA excerpt, and a Docusign link for the marketplace addendum.
3) Pilot: meter-only pilot for one internal team for 2 weeks, then switch full entitlement flow on.

I've cc'd Aditya and Marissa to scope the API surface and the pilot ops runbook. Let me know which times this week work for Acme.

Attachments: proposed-gateway-sequence.png (diagram), entitlement-state-map.csv (mapping)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 13:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption gateway design + entitlement handoff (AWS Marketplace)

Neha / team —

Couple of engineering points to call out (so Acme has clear expectations):

- Event flow & idempotency: Each AWS metering event will carry marketplace_transaction_id and usage_sequence. Our ingestion returns a 200/accepted with a redwood_event_id. We expect Acme to ack via our entitlement acceptance endpoint (POST /entitlements/ack) with redwood_event_id to prevent double-enrollment.

- State machine (from entitlement-state-map.csv): PENDING -> CONFIRMED -> ACTIVE -> SUSPENDED -> CANCELLED. We include a TTL on PENDING (72h) after which the event is marked for manual review if no confirmation.

- Backfill & retries: We provide a backfill endpoint for transactions up to 45 days old. For webhook delivery failures, we'll retry with exponential backoff up to 5 attempts and then mark as failed and surface in the console + alert to ops emails.

- Billing edge case: For overlapping subscriptions where market subscription B starts before A's end, we will generate prorated usage records and include "prorate_factor" + "effective_from" fields. We do not auto-deduct seats; Acme must choose whether to extend or consolidate entitlements.

I'll prepare a short swagger snippet for the entitlement ack and backfill endpoints before the sync. For pilot, ops will need write access to Acme's sandbox tenant; Marissa can coordinate.

- Aditya
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

Neha / Aditya —

This looks good and answers most procurement questions. Quick clarifications before we lock the timeline:

1) TTL on PENDING: 72h is acceptable. Who is the owner for manual review alerts (person/team)?
2) Backfill window: Acme needs at least 30 days; 45 is great — will confirm with our finance team.
3) Evidence packet: Can you send SOC2 summary + SLA excerpt before the sync? Our procurement lead wants to attach to the PO.

Proposed timeline:
- Wed 8/1 (should read 9/1?) 30-min tech sync to agree payloads and ack flows.
- Pilot start: 9/6 for 2 weeks.

Also, small ask: can Redwood provide a short runbook snippet that describes retries & manual reconciliation steps (ops playbook)? If you can drop that into the Drive link you shared, we'll use it for our SRE team.

If the above is fine I'll route to Procurement and lock calendar.

Thanks —
Stuart
Head of Platform Integrations, Acme Labs
